summary: Spectral effect on a short-time spectrum (FFT 1024 to 8192, 4x overlap) with five sections that can all run, in this order: Spectral pitch (a semitone and cents shift, phase-locked so a chord stays clear, with Formant keep), Scramble (swaps bins within bands, seeded, at a rate or in sync), Freeze (holds the spectrum, from a switch, a note or the song), Blur (smooths the spectrum over up to 4 s and across frequency) and Spectral delay (a delay that tilts from low to high frequencies, with feedback and damping). Mix and Amount; the reported latency is one frame. Use it for frozen chords, washed pads, bin-shuffle glitches, shimmer, formant-kept pitch shifts and rising spectral echoes.
use_for: Spectral effects on a track: freeze a chord, wash a pad, shuffle the bins into glitches, shift the pitch by semitones with formants kept, or echo low and high frequencies at different times.

parameters.name: Pitch
parameters.description: The spectral pitch shift: on or off
parameters.how: Turns the spectral pitch shift on or off.
parameters.sound: On, every partial in the sound moves by the same number of semitones.

parameters.name: Semitones
parameters.description: Shift in semitones, -24 to +24
parameters.how: Sets the shift in whole semitones.
parameters.sound: Seven up is a fifth above, twelve up an octave, twelve down an octave below.

parameters.name: Cents
parameters.description: Fine shift in cents, added to the semitones
parameters.how: Adds a fine shift in cents (a hundredth of a semitone) to the semitones.
parameters.sound: A few cents make a slow chorus-like beat against the dry sound; use it with Mix.

parameters.name: Formant keep
parameters.description: Keeps the spectral envelope (the formants) where it was while the partials move
parameters.how: Moves the partials but keeps the broad spectral envelope in place.
parameters.sound: A voice shifted up still sounds like the same person instead of a chipmunk.

parameters.name: Scramble
parameters.description: The bin scramble: on or off
parameters.how: Turns the bin scramble on or off.
parameters.sound: On, the bins inside each band are shuffled between themselves.

parameters.name: Scramble amount
parameters.description: The share of the bins that are swapped
parameters.how: Sets the share of the bins in each band that are moved.
parameters.sound: Low values blur the detail a little, high values turn the sound into a glitchy cloud.

parameters.name: Band width
parameters.description: Bins that are shuffled together (a band)
parameters.how: Sets how many neighbouring bins are shuffled between themselves.
parameters.sound: Narrow bands keep the tone and add grit, wide ones scatter the pitch.

parameters.name: Scramble sync
parameters.description: How often the shuffle changes: Free (the Rate in Hz) or a length in the song
parameters.how: Chooses whether a new shuffle comes at a free rate or on the beat grid of the song.
parameters.sound: Synced shuffles change in time with the music, free ones drift.

parameters.name: Scramble rate
parameters.description: New shuffles per second, when the sync is Free
parameters.how: Sets how many new shuffles come each second.
parameters.sound: Slow rates give a stable scatter, fast rates a fizzing texture.

parameters.name: Scramble seed
parameters.description: The seed of the shuffles: the same seed always gives the same sequence
parameters.how: Picks which sequence of shuffles is used.
parameters.sound: Different seeds give different glitch patterns; the same seed repeats exactly.

parameters.name: Freeze
parameters.description: Holds the current spectrum (when the trigger is Switch)
parameters.how: Holds the spectrum as it is now, each partial running on at its own frequency.
parameters.sound: The sound turns into a steady, endless chord made from what was playing.

parameters.name: Freeze trigger
parameters.description: What freezes: the Freeze switch, a note, or the song
parameters.how: Chooses whether the switch, a held note or the beat grid freezes the sound.
parameters.sound: Note freezes for as long as a key is down, Synced catches the sound at the start of every period.

parameters.name: Freeze every
parameters.description: Synced: how often a new freeze is caught
parameters.how: Sets how often a synced freeze catches the sound.
parameters.sound: Short periods make a stepping chord, long ones hold a pad for bars.

parameters.name: Freeze length
parameters.description: Synced: how long each freeze is held
parameters.how: Sets how long each synced freeze is held.
parameters.sound: Short holds clip the frozen sound off between catches.

parameters.name: Hold blend
parameters.description: How much of the output is frozen (100 %) and how much live; fades over at least 20 ms
parameters.how: Blends the live and the frozen spectrum; the change takes at least 20 ms.
parameters.sound: Half and half lets new notes ring over the held chord.

parameters.name: Blur
parameters.description: The spectral blur: on or off
parameters.how: Turns the blur on or off.
parameters.sound: On, the sound is smeared in time and in frequency.

parameters.name: Blur time
parameters.description: Smooths each bin's level over this time
parameters.how: Sets how slowly each frequency's level follows the sound.
parameters.sound: Long times wash notes into a pad that outlasts them.

parameters.name: Smear
parameters.description: Smooths the level across this many bins either side
parameters.how: Spreads each frequency's level over its neighbours.
parameters.sound: Smear softens the tone into a wash without changing its pitch.

parameters.name: Delay
parameters.description: The spectral delay: on or off
parameters.how: Turns the spectral delay on or off.
parameters.sound: On, low and high frequencies come back at different times.

parameters.name: Low time
parameters.description: Delay of the lowest frequencies
parameters.how: Sets the delay time at the bottom of the spectrum.
parameters.sound: Short low times with long high times make the highs trail behind.

parameters.name: High time
parameters.description: Delay of the highest frequencies
parameters.how: Sets the delay time at the top of the spectrum.
parameters.sound: Long high times make a rising or falling spectral echo.

parameters.name: Delay sync
parameters.description: Free: the times as set; otherwise each time is rounded to a multiple of this note at the song's tempo
parameters.how: Rounds both delay times to a multiple of a note length of the song.
parameters.sound: Synced delays echo in time with the music.

parameters.name: Feedback
parameters.description: Share of the delayed spectrum fed back in (kept below 100 %)
parameters.how: Feeds the delayed sound back into the delay.
parameters.sound: More feedback gives more repeats; it is always kept below 100 % so it dies away.

parameters.name: Damping
parameters.description: Extra loss of high frequencies at every repeat
parameters.how: Makes each repeat darker than the one before.
parameters.sound: High damping turns the repeats into a dark, fading wash.

parameters.name: FFT size
parameters.description: Frame size: larger is smoother for tones and pads, smaller is tighter for beats; also the latency (size minus 1)
parameters.how: Sets the size of the analysis frame, which is also the latency.
parameters.sound: Small frames keep drums sharp, large ones keep chords and pads clean.

parameters.name: Mix
parameters.description: Dry/wet (the dry signal is delayed by the latency)
parameters.how: Blends the processed sound with the dry input.
parameters.sound: Lower values keep the original and lay the effect on top.

parameters.name: Amount
parameters.description: Effect strength: 100 % = the settings as they stand, 0 = clean (bit for bit the input), 200 % = exaggerated
parameters.how: Scales the shift, the scramble, the blur, the delay times and the feedback together.
parameters.sound: Turn it down to fade the effect out, up to push it harder; at 0 the sound is clean.
